articleTitle: Using FGSM Targeted Attack to Improve the Transferability of Adversarial Example
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: At present, many people pay attention to the safety problems of artificial intelligence, and the emergence of adversarial examples is one of these problems. The adversarial examples can be used to attack a neural network classification model to make its classification wrong. It is an important method to improve the attack effect of adversarial examples by improving the transferability of adversarial examples and enabling them to attack multiple different neural network classification models at the same time. When we use FGSM algorithm to attack a model, first, we set ϵ a medium magnitude value, and then use targeted attack, which can improve the transferability of the adversarial examples generated by this algorithm. We can use FGSM algorithm to carry out white-box attack on the neural network model. The first step is to set a fixed value. Then, because FGSM algorithm is non-targeted attack, when adding a termination condition of iterative attack, we can use FGSM algorithm to carry out targeted attack, so that the generated adversarial examples can be identified as specific tags by the neural network model. We found that the transferability of the adversarial examples generated in this way is improved and these adversarial examples can attack many different neural network models.

articleTitle: Wearing Safety Helmet Detection in Substation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Wearing safety helmet is very essential for the safety of staff of power substations. In this paper, it proposes a detection framework of safety helmet based on the theory of machine learning and image processing technology. TensorFlow model enables to detect pedestrians, while the head position will be detected by the analysis of human Head-to-Body Ratio. Then the color space transformation and the color feature discrimination of head position are used to detect whether the staff wearing safety helmets or not. The experimental results of a large number of substation monitoring video sequences have shown that the recognition rate of wearing safety helmet detection system reach 89.0%, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Design of Integrated Service Platform Based on Satellite Mobile Communication System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Satellite mobile communication is considered to be the most effective means of wide coverage because of its stable operation, less interference, flexible networking, independent of communication cost and wide area coverage, which is not limited by geographical environment. Remote communication, high-speed real-time data transmission, covering a wide range of demand have become the main technical bottleneck restricting the economic construction of ocean, emergency, IOT and so on. Tiantong 1 satellite mobile communication system is the first generation of large capacity GEO satellite mobile communication system which was built independently in China. The system uses multi-beam coverage of national territory and territorial sea, can provide voice, short message, fax, data and image and other services, with resource autonomous controllable, all-weather service, no communication blind area, transmission security and reliability, high facility invulnerability, connectivity with the public network, suitable for pillar industries and government agencies and other key sector applications, and has unique advantages in emergency communication, IOT and mass communication and universal service. At the same time, satellite resources are relatively limited, bandwidth, rate, power and so on are limited, cannot be expanded as much as the ground mobile network, therefore, combining with different types of application requirements, it is urgent to build an integrated service platform based on “Tiantong 1” satellite mobile communication system, which plays an important role in navigation monitoring, IOT applications, emergency disaster relief, intelligent cities and so on. Build a relatively perfect Chinese satellite mobile communication service network, and further give full play to the benefits of information base support

articleTitle: Multi-modal Neural Network for Traffic Event Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Cities are composed of complex systems with Cyber, Physical, and Social (CPS) components. The advances in the Internet of Things (IoTs) and social networking services help people understand the dynamics of cities. Traffic event detection is an important while complex task in transportation modeling and management of smart cities. In this paper, we address the task of detecting traffic events using two types of data, i.e. physical sensor observations and social media text. Unlike most existing studies focused on either analysing sensor observations or social media data, we identify traffic events with both types of data that may complement each other. We propose a Multi-modal Neural Network (MMN) to process sensor observations and social media texts simultaneously and detect traffic events. We evaluate our model with a real-world CPS dataset consisting of sensor observations, event reports, and tweets collected from Twitter about San Francisco over a period of 4 months. The evaluation shows promising results and provides insights into the analysis of multi-modal data for detecting traffic events.

articleTitle: Review of EV's Wireless Charging Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Development of electric vehicles (EV) is the demand for energy-saving and low-carbon economy. The charging device of the electric vehicle is equivalent to the filling station of the automobile fuel, and the wireless charging technology is a new type of electric vehicle energy supply mode. With the continuous development and progress of technology, the wireless power transfer (WPT) technology has attracted wide spread attention recently. Especially in some specific occasions, the WPT technology has its unique advantages, which do not exist in the tradition V-MODE based on the wired power supply, to greatly improve the reliability, convenience and safety of power supply. In this paper, on the basis of in-depth study of literature, the development, application situation and the latest progress of wireless power technology are introduced, problems of wireless charging technology research are pointed out, which provides a new way for further research.

Author Keywords: magnetic resonant coupled wireless power transfer

articleTitle: Traveling Wave Fault Location for Lines Combined with Overhead-Lines and Cables Based on Empirical Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: D-type fault location method commonly used for hybrid line fault location is susceptible to the problem of asynchronous time difference of detection points, this paper proposes a single terminal fault location method for hybrid lines. Firstly, the segmentation criterion is constructed by using the feature of zero mode and line mode wave velocity difference, and then the fault location is completed by the single terminal method of zero mode and line mode wave speed difference. EMD can realize adaptive decomposition of traveling wave signals, but there is a problem of mode aliasing. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a traveling wave detection method based on empirical wavelet transform, which decomposes the fault traveling wave signal by EWT, and then uses the high frequency EMF2 component to accurately calibrate the traveling wave head. A large number of simulation results show that the fault location results of the proposed method are accurate and reliable.

articleTitle: A Maintainability Evaluation Method for Wireless Sensor Networks Based on AHP and Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: With the wide applications of wireless sensor networks (WSNs), the maintenance of WSNs is becoming more and more important. WSNs are generally powered by batteries and are difficult to retract once they are deployed. Therefore maintainability must be considered before deployment. After the system is in use, we also need know which networking area has poor maintainability so that we can take the necessary measures in time. This paper proposes a method for evaluating the maintainability of WSNs based on analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FEC) from the system perspective. Firstly, we analyze the factors affecting the maintainability of WSNs, which is evaluated hierarchically by calculating AHP. The main factors are hardware and software of the WSN nodes, wireless communication unit, and working environment, which are divided into several sub-factors that affect the maintainability. Under the ambiguous environment, various factors are considered when evaluating the maintainability of WSNs through AHP. The maintainability is determined by weighted sub-factors and main factors. Finally, by evaluating the maintainability of the WSNs, the proposed method can provide a guidance in the WSN design, manufacture, network deployment, and maintenance.

articleTitle: Home IoT Intrusion Prevention Strategy Based on Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Due to the sheer number and heterogeneity of IoT devices, it is not possible to secure the IoT ecosystem using traditional endpoint and network security solutions. To address the requirements of securing IoT devices in edge home networks, this paper proposed a strategy capable of securing the network against most malicious activity in real-time. Firstly, we use an edge smart gateway, which is deployed on a Raspberry-Pi, runs an SDN controller and Open vSwtich (OVS) to perform traffic monitoring, anomaly detection, and traffic filtering. Then, with limited resources available on edge gateway, we use a lightweight machine-learning algorithm to classify device to device traffic and identify if there is a network intrusion. The classification model extracts features of network traffic, trained by classic supervised learning method-Decision Tree J48, then distinguish between benign and malicious traffic patterns observed in the network. Simulation results show that the model has high accuracy of intrusion and can effectively ensure security of home IoT interactions.

articleTitle: An Effective Vehicle Counting Approach Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Vehicle counting is an essential part of the intelligent transportation system (ITS). Compared with traditional vehicle detection methods, convolutional neural network (CNN) could reach in real-time speed with high accuracy in vehicle detection. This paper presents an efficient and robust method of vehicle counting by combining CNN and the virtual coils. Experimental results indicate that our approach could remove duplicate and missing detection effectively and count the vehicle at high speed with around 98% relative accuracy and 93% absolute accuracy on average while it could also work well in the traffic jam situation with over 95% relative and 84% absolute accuracy. Besides, through identifying the traffic light color, the proposed method could also be applied in automatically capturing red light violations.

articleTitle: Viewer-Oriented CDN Scheduling on Crowdsourced Live Video Stream
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In crowdsourced live video stream platforms, viewers are spread all over the world. To improve the Quality of Experience (QoE), streams are distributed to the content distribution network (CDN) deployed in different regions, and viewers are assigned to the closest CDN to watch live broadcast. Currently, in these platforms, like Douyu and Twitch, the stream distribution strategy is based on the popularity of stream, without considering viewers' engagement, which is significant to the platform. In this paper, taking Douyu as a case, we conduct a detailed analysis of the platform. Our results show the gap between popularity based stream distribution strategy and platform's profit. To fill the gap, we propose a viewer-oriented algorithm to distribute stream and determine viewer's streaming source based on viewer's engagement, which targets maximize platform's profit. We examine our algorithm using real trace of Douyu. The results indicate that our algorithm can improve the overall profit of platform and uniformity of load in CDN with low scheduling cost.

articleTitle: Design of Self-Biased LVDS Receiver for DAC in High Speed DDS Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: A Low Voltage Differential Signal (LVDS) receiver with self-bias circuit for DAC of DDS system is presented in the paper. The circuit achieved in SMIC 180 nm standard CMOS process, and simulation results indicate that the proposed LVDS receiver is suitable for IEEE LVDS protocol. The circuit occupies a die area of 49 μm * 22 μm, and consumes a power of 0.326 mW from 1.8 V supply with 500 MS/s sampling rate. Meanwhile, RMS jitter is only 15 ps by the eye diagram simulation. It has been confirmed that the circuit is suitable for high speed DACs.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of Multipath Effect in High Precision Satellite Communication Based on Ray-Tracing Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The multipath caused by solar panels cannot be ignored in satellite high precision communication. Based on multipath theory, the corresponding multipath estimation model is established by ray-tracing. The model is used to simulate the multipath error caused by solar panels during the communication between the LEO orbit satellite and the Beijing ground station. And we summarize the periods of time suitable for high precision communication. The simulation results are consistent with the actual situation, which indicates that the method adopted in this paper has the ability to achieve efficient and accurate multipath estimation. The conclusion of this paper also has important engineering significance for the layout of other payloads near the communication payload and the properly planning of communication resources.

articleTitle: Transformer Inrush Simulation And Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Power transformer inrush current discrimination has always been the main task of transformer current differential protection. The power transformer will generate two kinds of inrush currents, namely, the sympathetic inrush current and the magnetizing inrush current. It is still a difficult problem to distinguish the two inrush currents of the power transformer. In this thesis, MATLAB is used to simulate and analyze the sympathetic inrush current and the magnetizing inrush current of three-phase transformers. The characteristics of the two waveforms are simulated. The simulation analysis of the sympathetic inrush current and magnetizing inrush current will help the inrush current of the transformer. methodological study.

articleTitle: High and Low Frequency Control Strategy for APF DC Side Ripple Voltage under Unbalanced Load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The problem of the APF (Active Power Filter) compensation ability is reduced when the grid has an unbalanced load. Firstly, the positive and negative sequence mathematical models are established based on parallel APF with LCL. The main reason for the generation of higher harmonics on both sides of the APF AC and DC is the fundamental sequence negative component of the system. The high and low frequency mathematical expressions of the DC side voltage are obtained, and the design controller controls the negative sequence and the positive sequence of the system separately, thereby suppressing the DC side ripple voltage and the AC side harmonic current. Finally, the simulation is carried out from both steady state and dynamics, and compared with the conventional PI, the results show the superiority of the control strategy.

Author Keywords: high and low frequency mathematical model

articleTitle: Design of Anti-interference System for Fully Autonomous UAV Based on ADRC- EKF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In order to solve the short-time drift problem of height data caused by environmental and noisy pollution, a multi-rotor aircraft control system was designed to prevent the aircraft from falling rapidly in a short time during the autonomous cruise. The problem of data loss due to strong interference on the UAV, which is equipped with the Real-time kinematic (RTK), can be well solved by introducing an inertial measurement unit (IMU) for high resolution, and using an Extended Kalman filter and IMU to calculate system acceleration (ACC) as well as altitude predictions for eliminating height drift due to sensor errors. In addition, the ADRC control algorithm is also introduced to control the attitude of the aircraft, to realize the control compensation, and finally to control the height of the drone through the three- ring cascade PID algorithm. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can make the UAV get better height and attitude control even though the external disturbance is unknown.

articleTitle: A Revocable Publish-Subscribe Scheme Using CP-ABE with Efficient Attribute and User Revocation Capability for Cloud Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of publish-subscribe systems in the cloud environment, it is of great value to implement an efficient and secure searchable and encrypted publishing subscription scheme with dynamic attributes in a cloud environment. In a publish-subscribe system, it is very important that the user's attributes can be dynamically changed. Most existing schemes which combine searchable encryption with attribute base encryption do not take real-time changes to user attributes into account or are inefficient. To address these problems, we propose a revocable publish-subscribe scheme (RPS) using CP-ABE with efficient attribute and user revocation capability for cloud systems. RPS supports multiple publishers and subscribers, and protects data from access of unauthorized users and cloud server. In addition, it also protects the privacy of the subscription policy, privacy of the uploaded data and keywords, and is forward and backward secure.

articleTitle: The Research on the 3L-Neural Point Clamp Isolation Bidirectional DC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Isolated bidirectional DC-DC converters-IBDCs, with the two-way power flow ability and the high frequency transformer isolation, are the critical units to connect the different kind power such as battery, generator and supercapacitors etc. The three level neural point clamp-3L-NPC IBDC can realize high voltage converting with the lower rated power switches and expand the power grade, and improve the electromagnetic compatibility as well. In this paper a two ports 3L-NPC IBDC was proposed and the control strategies of the 3L-NPC IBDC was invested in detail and the operation were divided into two modes according to relationship between the duty cycle of the inner bridge and the phase shift ratio of the two bridges. The leakage inductance current, the output voltage and the transfer power characteristics are analyzed and the analytical expressions were given according the two operation modes respectively. The average current of the neural point must be kept at zero to ensure the two clamp capacitors have the approximately equal voltage in one period in the both operation modes. The results show that the 3L-NPC IBDCs are feasible and have a good prospect application in the high power conversion.

articleTitle: Double PI Control of DC Link Voltage for Three-Phase Four-Wire Shunt Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: DC link voltage control is the key technology of shunt APF. The magnitude of DC link voltage affects the power loss and compensation capability of APF. In a complex industrial environment, load fluctuations will cause grid voltage fluctuations at common coupling points, which will further affect the compensation capability of active power filters. This paper analyzed the DC link voltage of three-phase four-wire shunt APF. The combination of conventional PI control and fuzzy control is adopted to stabilize the DC link voltage. Finally, based on simulation analysis and experiments, the scheme is proved to be effective.

articleTitle: Efficient Matchline Controller for Hybrid Content Addressable Memory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Low-energy dissipation as well as high-speed matching are two goals in the design of content addressable memories (CAMs). An efficient matchline (ML) controller is proposed in this work to achieve a low-power hybrid CAM while maintaining acceptable performance for search. This is applied in the implementation of 128×32-bit CAM using 45-nm CMOS technology. Short and fast discharged ML path of the proposed controller makes it possible for the CAM to provide 58.56% and 13.11% improvement in search-speed over a conventional NAND-based CAM and a hybrid-type CAM, respectively. The result of shorter NAND-ML controlling the longer NOR-ML is able to suppress not only mismatched but also partial matched NOR- MLs, so that power is saved during search operation. While the average-power consumption is only 3.93 μW, lesser by 30.69 % than the low-power NAND-CAM, the 32-bit word produces ML state in 3.58 ns search time leading to the improvement in energy-delay by 1.21, 2.16 and 4.95 times from the existed hybrid-type, NOR-ML and NAND-ML CAMs, respectively. Energy metric of proposed design, obtained as 0.17 fJ/bit/search under 1 V supply, is the least among the compared designs.

articleTitle: Research on Chip Test Method for Improving Test Quality
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: As the integration level of chip increases, the mass testing after wafer fabrication has become more and more complex. How to improve the quality of chip testing has become an important issue. In this paper, several chip test methods that can be used for mass production are studied in combination with our actual test examples. These methods can improve the chip test coverage, reduce the early failure rate of the chip and improve the chip reliability, thus improving the quality of the chip test.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of OFDM-PON Combined with Polarization Multiplexing and Coherent Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: This paper proposes a passive optical network unit structure based on orthogonal frequency division multiplexing, which combines polarization multiplexing and coherent detection techniques. In optical line terminal, quadrature amplitude modulation intensity-modulated orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing signals at 10 Gb/s are utilized for x-polarized downstream transmission. After fiber transmission, unmodulated y-polarized light in the optical network unit can be used not only as a local oscillator for downstream signal demodulation, but also as a source for upstream 2.5 Gb/s on-off keying signals. In this architecture, Time Division Multiple Access is used for upstream multiplexing transmission to achieve optimal compatibility and low cost. The performance of the proposed system is demonstrated by bit error rate and constellation diagram.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Drivers and Selectors for Content Addressable Memory (CAM)
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Content addressable memory (CAM) is a hardware search engine used for speeding look-up operation in various applications. CAM implementation requires several input and output driver circuits for writing/searching/matching. This paper presents the required I/O processing peripherals with all necessary circuits, dedicated functionality and discussions for completing a CAM architecture. Row decoder (address input decoder) activates a specific row in an array so that bitline drivers come into operation to store predefined data at the specified CAM cells. Search driver fetches user defined data and pass on to the parallel search lines of each location of CAM array. Column of sense amplifiers associating match-lines (MLs) of each location process the voltage change in the MLs during a CAM search. Priority encoder (address output encoder) is used at the last stage to code the address of the matching location, a priority is usually used in case of multiple matches to decide the best match location. These encoders and decoders should work in synchronous with the related drivers for CAM read-in (write) and read-out (search/matching) operations in their respective cycles. These utilities of driver circuits for CAM will be helpful and ease of reference for memory designers while integrating proper choice of peripheral circuits in a memory chip.

articleTitle: Buck Converter for Noise-Isolating Power Supplies
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Buck converter is a circuit in which the output voltage is smaller than the input voltage, and in this sense is also called a step-down converter. Recently, due to the development of high-density integrated circuit technology, small and light electric and electronic devices, industrial equipment causes fatal losses even with very small power differences. Therefore, a stable power supply is needed. In this paper, we propose a circuit that uses a filter for safe power supply to the input and output stages of a non-isolated buck converter. We experimentally saw the results of the noise isolation.

articleTitle: Research on Interaction and Optimal Configuration of Multi-Power Quality Regulator in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In the current distribution network, various types of devices based on DFACTS are used to improve power quality. Due to the wide variety of DFACTS devices, different functions and flexible applications, coupled with the problem of electrical coupling between devices, different or repeated control objectives, multiple DFACTS devices will have certain interaction effects and directly affect the power quality. In this paper, the interaction of multiple DFACTS devices in the distribution system is studied with the IEEE33 node power distribution system taken as the research object. An improved genetic algorithm(GA) is used to optimize the configuration of DFACTS, the interaction between DAFCTS devices and the results of optimized configuration are Quantitatively calculated based on the relative gain array (RGA) method. The simulation model is built and the simulation results confirm the correctness and effectiveness of the RAG method applied to the optimal configuration of the DFACTS devices.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Control System of Substrate Lettuce Cultivation Based on Light-Dependent Irrigation Control Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The light-dependent irrigation control method is currently a relatively advanced greenhouse production irrigation control method. However, in domestic greenhouse applications, the empirical parameters imported from abroad are basically used. Due to the inconsistent climatic conditions, there is a problem that the plant growth cannot be accurately controlled. In order to promote the application of the light-dependent irrigation control method in the production of domestic facilities, combined with the substrate moisture content and the electrical conductivity of substrate leachate, the fuzzy control method is used to further adjust the irrigation amount and the electrical conductivity of irrigation nutrition, which precisely controls greenhouse irrigation and fertilization. According to the experimental comparison, there is no difference between the advanced method and the traditional light-dependent irrigation control method on the yield of lettuce, but the water use efficiency of the plant is improved under the premise of ensuring growth.

articleTitle: A New Polar Code SCF Method Based on Effective Flip Bits
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Although the SC-Flip decoder can significantly avoids the effects of cumulative errors by flipping the first erroneous bit of the traditional SC decoder, the computational complexity of the SCF increases simultaneously. In this letter, to reduce the computational complexity of the SCF decoder, we investigate the log-likelihood ratio (LLR) values and their distribution related to the erroneous bit-channels, then replace the LLR sorting method of SC-Flip with a new value. By setting a threshold for the bits to flip, we proposed a SC-Flip decoder using effective flip bits (SCF-EF). Simulation results demonstrate that for practical code lengths (1024, 512), SCF-EF can achieve 21.37% complexity reduction at SNR of 0.5dB with negligible loss compared with the BLER performance when correcting all single-errors.

articleTitle: M2M Clustering Method in Urban Distribution Network (UDN) Considering Delay Sensitive Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In the 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> generation network communication, by deploying UDN (urban distribution network) to increase the wireless network capacity, most of the current articles consider H2H communication under UDN, while ignoring M2M communication. M2M communication under UDN is mainly established by MTCG and core network. The MTCG deployment is based on different MTCD (machine-to-machine type communication) methods. The location and density of the MTCD is a major consideration in MTCG deployment. However, for large heterogeneous networks such as UDN, geolocation-based clustering methods are often used to enable UDNs to adapt to this complex large-scale network architecture. This paper considers the delay-tolerant devices in M2M clustering and prioritizes access to such devices.

articleTitle: A SWP Interface Module Verification Method Based on UVM
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The single wire protocol (SWP) interface is a new type of interface for SIM card chips used in eNFC mobile payment solutions. In order to achieve a full verification of the SWP interface, a module-level verification environment is built based on the universal verification methodology (UVM). Our work proves that the full-duplex communication mode of the SWP interface is very suitable for using random incentives of the UVM, which can greatly improve the efficiency of interface module verification. In addition, compared to traditional verification methods using directional incentives described by Verilog, The UVM-based verification method can achieve a richer and more comprehensive verification scenario.

articleTitle: Carry Chain Test of Xilinx FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for the carry chain test of the Xilinx FPGAs. The method is a build-in-self-test one. It needs only a few intentionally designed inputs which is equivalent to all of the possible combinations, and therefore no longer needs a large number of randomly generated inputs to cope with combination explosion. Some series of Xilinx FPGAs have vacant areas where no carry chain exists. The vacancy creates difficulty for testing. We develop a method to solve this problem. The theory of our method and FPGA implementation results demonstrate that our method is elegant in test coverage and efficiency.

articleTitle: Architecture and Key Technologies of the V2X-based Vehicle Networking
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: V2X is the key link of vehicle networking technology and an important means to realize intelligent transportation system. V2X enables the vehicle networking platform to acquire real-time road information through information exchange between vehicles and vehicles, between vehicles and road facilities, between vehicles and pedestrians, and between vehicles and mobile internet. After gathering and analyzing the information of the external environment, it can feed back to the vehicle terminal in real time to provide vehicle driving. Intelligent decision-making basis can improve the efficiency of traffic management, reduce the probability of safety accidents, and realize unmanned automatic driving. Firstly, the communication requirement of V2X is discussed, two kinds of V2X technical standards are analyzed, and the technical framework of vehicle networking is given. Secondly, several key technologies for the development of V2X vehicle networking are pointed out. Finally, several typical applications of V2X technology are given.

articleTitle: Establishment and Simulation of DG Model Based on PQ Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In this paper, the principle of PQ control strategy is elaborated according to the grid-connected operation state of distributed power generation. The transfer functions of current loop and power loop are deduced through the circuit structure of the inverter and its mathematical model in the dq coordinate system. A typical I-type system scheme is adopted to design the current inner loop, and the control strategy model is built based on the simulation platform of MATLAB/Simulink, which verifies the validity and correctness of the model. The simulation results show that the system has good stability and dynamic performance, and the model can be used to study the grid-connected control of distributed generation, which has a certain reference significance.

articleTitle: Can Active Learning Benefit the Smart Grid? A Perspective on Overcoming the Data Scarcity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In the past decade, a plethora of efforts were given to the field of facilitating a better smart grid system by leveraging the power of artificial intelligence. Undoubtedly, machine learning is currently playing an increasingly important role in almost every aspect of power systems. However, in real practice, there is a much larger amount of unlabelled data than the one labelled by human experts. In this work, we make a perspective study on overcoming the data scarcity in smart grid. The active learning strategy will be proposed to provide a feasible solution for addressing the data scarcity challenge. In addition, we will give a discussion on current state-of-the-art and the limitations in previous work. We hope this work can be a good guide for researchers to further the relevant study in the near future.

articleTitle: Multi-power Quality Controller Coordination Control Based on Multi-objective Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In a distribution network system with multiple power quality controllers, the control effect of each power quality controller is to ensure that the power quality of the access node can reach the expected goal, but due to the interaction effect between the power quality controllers, power quality controllers adopted in the local control of calculated to adjust instruction, unable to realize multiple nodes distribution system power quality at the same time to reach the expected aim. In this paper, for IEEE 33-node standard distribution network system, the nodes contraction method is firstly adopted to eliminate irrelevant nodes, the expression of interaction effect mechanism between power quality controllers is derived, and the relative gain system matrix (RGA) is introduced to quantitatively analyze the degree of interaction effect between controllers Then USES the master-slave control structure with central controller, selection of multi-objective particle swarm optimization (MOPSO) applied to the central controller of the coordinated control calculation, through multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm to get a group can make the distribution network system in the assessment of more nodes at the same time to achieve the desired effect of optimal solution set, and then by the central controller according to the optimal solution set distribution adjust instruction to the assessment of each node power quality controller is carried out. PSCAD simulation results show that the coordinated control effect is good.

articleTitle: A Method of Dynamic Container Layer Replacement for Faster Service Providing on Resource-Limited Edge Nodes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: As the edge cloud technology evolves, research is underway to provide customers with a serverless architecture-based FaaS (Function as a Service) on the edge nodes. However, serverless architecture-based FaaS on the edge nodes has a problem with resource management due to edge nodes with relatively lower computing power than the cloud data centers. And also it has a late service provision problem due to time to prepare cloud instances for customer API call requests. In this paper, we propose the method of dynamic container layer replacement considering a resource-limited environment on the edge nodes while mitigating cold start and then shows the performance.

articleTitle: Research of Accurate Digital Integrator for Rogowski Coil Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In this paper, the integral precision and the DC drift problem in the digital integrator for the electronic current transformer based on Rogowski coil are studied. The related algorithms such as the integral algorithm and characteristics of DC offset problems are studied in depth. Based on these, a new digital integration algorithm is proposed by adding a delay factor α, increasing the sampling frequency, etc. A new data structure is designed by adding DC feedback, adding dual channel, etc. The simulation model built in MATLAB proves the good effect of the two aspects of the design. Compared with conventional integrators, the new digital integrator with the improved algorithm can obtain frequency responses closer to those of ideal integrator. The new data structure can effectively overcome the DC offset problems in the electronic current transformer. Further simulation results show that the designed digital integration algorithm has high accuracy, the absolute error of phase response does not exceed 1°, and the absolute error of magnitude response does not exceed 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>(dB). The new data processing structure can completely solve the DC drift problem after about 7 cycles.

articleTitle: A Review of Medical Implants Communication in Body Area Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: An overview of medical implant communication in body area network is presented keeping in mind the readers from both engineering and medical science background. Starting from the very basic body area network topology, the paper shows the general architecture for the design of implantable transceiver Integrated Circuit (IC). Most of the work is focused on the Medical Implant Communication Service (MICS) band from 402 to 405 MHz. We have also presented a recent energy harvesting technique for battery-less implantable IC and test method for the implants operating in MICS band. Mostly the review is done based on IEEE 802.15.6, ETSI EN 301 839-1, and ITU-R Recommendation RS 1346 standards.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Constellation Modulated Visible Light Communications with Pixelated Addressable Micro-LED Array
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In this paper, we improved the VPPM (Variable- Pulse-Position-Modulation) modulation mode referred to the PHY II based on the research about the short distance visible light communication IEEE 802.15.7 standard, and put forward a compound digital baseband modulation method named VPPM-DPAM (Variable-Pulse-Position-Modulation-Discrete Pulse-Amplitude-Modulation) which is suitable for indoor white Micro-LED array by introducing the DPAM based on the dispersion of light intensity, the modulated method we presented not only improves the communication speed of the system but also provides an accurate dimming mechanism for indoor adjustable luminance lighting which realizes the integration of communication lighting. What's more, we further discussed the constellation design in three-dimensional optimization of VPPM-DPAM which focused on the nonconvex optimization problem, found that the communication performance and lighting performance of the system have a constraint relation which was verified in both simulation and experiment. Finally, a visual light communication system based on DPAM-VPPM with compatible communication and lighting performance is obtained with certain anti-noise capability.

articleTitle: Research on Differentiation Inspection Strategy of Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: At present, there is a lack of unified standards and procedures for patrol inspection of distribution network, the patrol strategy/task needs to be formulated manually, and the patrol path is also freely developed by the patrol personnel, which is affected by the level of personnel, and is prone to the absence of important patrol items/inadequate patrol of some equipment and so on. This paper comprehensively considers the important level and real-time status of distribution equipment, determines the different inspection levels of distribution equipment, and forms a differentiated inspection strategy for distribution equipment in combination with the benchmark inspection cycle. A heuristic function considering traffic information is proposed, and path optimization with the shortest time spent on inspections is achieved. The correctness and effectiveness of the optimization design method of the power distribution equipment inspection strategy are verified by example.

articleTitle: Control Strategy of Voltage Reconfiguration Power Quality Integrated Conditioner Based on BESS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Aiming at high-end sensitive users with higher power quality requirements, a voltage reconfiguration power quality integrated control device based on BESS is studied. The device adopts back-to-back chain topology with BESS and double power supply to improve the reliability of power supply. The topological structure and mathematical model are analyzed. A control strategy of phase separation and constant voltage is proposed for the dual power supply and chain structure of the device. Taking a set of 1MVA/10kV voltage reconfiguration chain power quality comprehensive treatment device as an example, the simulation model of the device is built under PSCAD/EMTDC, and the control effect of the device on voltage sag, harmonic, three-phase unbalance, frequency change, voltage interruption, load side sudden change and unbalance is verified. The control effect is realized. Source-load decoupling can effectively improve the quality of power supply.

articleTitle: The Selection of Power Physical Contracts and Financial Contracts
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Physical contracts and financial contracts are common terms in the electricity market. However, due to the different contexts used, these two terms often have certain conceptual biases in actual research. The concepts of physical contracts and financial contracts, and the similarity between power physical contracts and financial contracts from the characteristics of the electric commodities are analyzed. Based on the summary of the typical foreign electricity market operation mode, the power contract transactions in the UK and PJM power market are taken as examples for in-depth analysis. The analysis shows that the actual electricity market construction does not have to be rigidly attached to the basic pattern of the electricity market, and the physical contracts or financial contracts can be selected according to the actual situation.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Least Squares Estimation on Equalization Using a Systemic Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The observed growth trend of the wireless communications market will drive the development of new wireless systems, including equalizers. Linear equalization is still a relatively low computational demand and easy-to- implement solution that may increase reliability in low data rate devices such as the ones required for IoT systems and wireless sensor networks. However, the relationship between the mean squared error (MSE) and the matrix correlation of the Least Squares (LS) estimation procedure, with the bit error rate (BER) of the system, has not been fully investigated. This paper presents a description of the simulated BER behavior, caused by the influence of the matrix correlation and MSE, through a causal analysis derived from a systems thinking approach. Then, it is proposed a descriptive hypothesis of the main cause and effect relationships involved in the generation of the BER behavior, using different training sequences in the LS optimization procedure.

articleTitle: Design of the Testing Software System for Front End Electronic Modules in LHAASO WCDA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: As an important part of LHAASO (Large High Altitude Air Shower Observatory), WCDA (Water Cerenkov Detector Array) includes 350 FEE (Front-End Electronics) modules, which are distributed over a 78000-m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> area. In WCDA FEEs, both charge and time measurement results are acquired and transferred to the DAQ (Data Acquisition System). This testing software system is designed to provide a convenient automatic test platform, which supports simultaneous testing of multiple FEEs. This paper presents the design and implementation of the software.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of Two Phase Locked Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Phase-locked loop (PLL) is the widely used method to obtain the frequency and phase of grid voltage, and its performance is critical to the overall control system. For traditional synchronous reference frame phase-locked loop (SRF-PLL), voltage amplitude and phase are seriously distorted in three phase unbalance, the performance of the control system is degraded. Based on the principle of three-phase software PLL, the method of double second-order generalized integral phase-locked loop (DSOGI-PNSC-PLL) is studied in this paper, which solves the problem of serious phase and frequency distortion in SRF-PLL when the grid voltage is unbalanced. The phase-locked performances of SRF-PLL and DSOGI-PNSC-PLL under unbalanced grid voltage are analyzed and compared by using MATLAB/Simulink simulation. The simulation results show that DSOGI-PNSC-PLL can accurately extract the frequency and phase of positive sequence components of voltage when the grid voltage is unbalanced, and has good phase-locked performance.

articleTitle: Price Competition and Value-Added Service Differentiation in Power Sale Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In the context of the full liberalization of the second round of electricity reform in China, the price competition and value-added service differentiation strategies of newly established power sales entities were studied. Based on the current situation of the sales side, the strategy of “price competition and value-added service differentiation” is proposed as the main countermeasure for the power sales entities to respond to the current market situation of power sales. On the basis of modern game theory, by mapping the relevant models in game theory to the power sale market, a two-stage model of price competition and value-added service differentiation is constructed to obtain relevant preliminary conclusions.

articleTitle: Polar Coding with Chaos and Frozen Bits Operation for Wiretap Channel
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: A chaos stream cipher embedded polar coding structure with frozen bits operation scheme is presented in this paper. Several solutions are proposed for solving the remaining problem of former encrypted polar coding scheme for symmetric and degraded wiretap channel. In the proposed structure, a chaos stream cipher is embedded for secure encryption. A solution for long key transmission over the wiretap channel is presented. A multi-block chaining structure is employed for achieving the secure and reliable transmission under the strong security criterion. And a frozen bits operation is constructed with the chaining structure to increase the error probability for unauthorized decoding. And our proposed scheme can also achieve an additional secrecy capacity for the symmetric and degraded wiretap channel.

articleTitle: Audio Feature Analysis for Trombone
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The trombone is a mid-bass instrument in the brass family, its tone is high, brilliant, solemn and full, and the sound is bright and powerful. When it is weak, it is gentle and euphemistic, and the tone is clear and unified. This paper introduces the classification and characteristics of the trombone, as well as the basic playing skills such as single spit method and double spit method. Then, the characteristic analysis of the trombone audio signal is carried out, and the audio of the single spit method and the double spit method is zero-crossing rate and short-time auto-correlation experiments, experimental analysis shows that the short-term auto correlation function can effectively obtain the pitch information of the audio.

articleTitle: CDF Analysis on Effect of Thermal Conductive Coating on Radiating Power of Panel Type Radiator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Based on CFD, the thermal conductivity of the coating material is studied, and the results show that the heat dissipation performance of the radiator is significantly reduced by the thermal conductivity of the smaller anticorrosive coating under the same structure and parameters. The mathematical model of three-dimensional single panel type radiator is established, the influence law of the heat conduction coefficient of the coating before and after the increase, the oil flow rates and the power of the fan on the temperature field distribution of the radiator is analyzed, and the results can provide reference for the optimal design of panel type radiator.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Transformer Loss Cost under Harmonic Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The first step in the power quality improvement is economic analysis. The harmonic influence on the safe operation of transformer could not be neglected. This paper takes transformer as an example. A calculation model of transformer loss cost is established under harmonic environment, fully considering the impact of the AC skin effect on the transformer loss cost. The change rule of transformer loss cost in condition with different current total harmonic distortion and different load rate is analyzed, and some important conclusions were derived: the harmonic load loss of transformer is proportional to the square of the load rate and the current total distortion, the harmonic load loss of transformer considering the effect of ac skin effect is 2.26 times of the one without. This paper has realized the quantified analysis of additional harmonic loss, which have important reference value in improving the economic operation of transformer and designing transformer capacity rationally.

articleTitle: A Receding Horizon Optimal Scheduling Method of Networked Charging System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: A novel receding horizon optimal scheduling algorithm is presented for the node devices charging process of a distributed electric barriers system where the power supply line capacity and the start-up current fluctuation rate are constrained. This optimal strategy aims at reducing the power supply current and avoiding the high start-up inrush current. Based on the analysis of system structure, a linear system model is established to describe the dynamic process, and the above two problems are formulated too. A nonlinear current reference trajectory is designed through comprehensive considering with the charging time, current amplitude and rate of current change, simultaneously. After adding the symbolic function, which can express the work state of the node devices, into the linear system model, then the model is reconstructed into a nonlinear system model. Furthermore, a discrete predictive model is established. The objective function is designed to minimize the variance of the predicted current and the reference current. Receding horizon optimal method is used to obtain the scheduling strategy. Performances of the system with the proposed receding horizon optimal method are verified by simulation results. The research results can be widely used in networked charging systems.

articleTitle: Equalization Filter Algorithm of Music Signal Based on Time-Frequency Domain Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In order to effectively remove the noise existing in the transmission process of music signal, this paper discusses the music signal filtering algorithm from two different angles of time domain and frequency domain, and designs two equalization filters with adjustable parameters. And through the experimental simulation algorithm, the corresponding first-order and second-order low-frequency signal filtering cases are discussed. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated. At the same time, the method can be generalized to the case of high-order equalization filtering.

articleTitle: Image Denoising Algorithm Based on Adaptive Singular Value Threshold
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Non-local similarity images play a huge role in image denoising tasks. Many of the existing denoising algorithms have problems in that the edge information is too smooth, the reconstruction details are insufficient, and artifacts are easily generated while removing noise. In order to solve these shortcomings and improve the denoising accuracy, we propose a denoising algorithm based on non-local similarity and adaptive singular value threshold (ASVT). The algorithm consists of three basic steps: block matching grouping, ASVT denoising, and aggregation. First, similar image patches are grouped by block matching method, and each similar block group is used as a group matrix for each column of the matrix. Then, under the framework of image non-local similarity and low rank approximation, the denoising problem is transformed into low rank matrix approximation problem, which is solved by ASVT. Finally, all processed image patches are aggregated to produce an initial denoised image. In order to effectively avoid the influence of noise residual on denoising, the denoising result is further improved by the back projection strategy, and more detailed features are retained. Experimental results clearly show that the proposed algorithm is competitive with the current state-of-the-art denoising algorithms in terms of both quantitative measure and subjective visual quality and can retain more details and improve the smoothing problem.

articleTitle: Optimization of Measuring Points of Fire Suppression and Suppression Circuit Board Based on Global Sensitivity Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of module-level and board-level fault diagnosis point selection for a certain type of fire suppression and explosion suppression system board, this paper uses the incentive and measurement point optimization method based on global sensitivity analysis to optimize the excitation and measuring points. The method uses Pspice software for simulation analysis, omitting the topology analysis and cumbersome calculation process of the sub-module circuit in the circuit board, and improving the selection efficiency of the measuring point. Considering the effects of component tolerance and parameter variation, the concept of global sensitivity is redefined, and the sensitivity of each measurement point under different excitation conditions is compared by global sensitivity analysis method, and the optimization of excitation and measurement points is completed. Point selection based on global sensitivity analysis is preferred.

articleTitle: Resolution of Misjudgment in Fault location of Transmission Line with Series Compensator Based on Electromagnetic Time Reversal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Application of wavelet-based electromagnetic time reversal (WEMTR) method to the transmission line with series compensator will lead to fault location results deviate greatly from the real fault point in a small section of the line when two-phase fault and three-phase fault occur. In view of this, on the basis of analyzing the cause of misjudgment, the traveling wave fault location principle, which does not rely on accurately capturing the time of signal mutation, is proposed to carry out initial position determination and is used as the screening criteria for the final results obtained by WEMTR. By comparison, this method can effectively eliminate misjudgment and make the fault location for series compensated line based on WEMTR more universal.

articleTitle: Adaptive Selection of Optimal Feature for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: We propose the Adaptive Selection of Optimal Feature (ASOF) module, a new approach utilizing anchor-free is used for object detection. Most of state-of-the-art object detectors are anchor-base, which use heuristic-guided anchor boxes. Such design is not suitable for detecting objects with different scale and aspect ratios, especially with highly overlapping borders. To address this gap, we propose ASOF, which assigns each instance to the most suitable feature layers by combining pre-defined setting with automatic feature selection. Each instance pass through the forward network to select one FPN layer by manual control, then using the automatic control to revise the former result to achieve the optimal feature map. Through such strategy, we separate most of the overlapping targets. Numerical results suggest that our method has better robustness for mAP than the method with anchor-based detector.

articleTitle: Power Quality Composite Disturbance Recognition Based on Grid Optimization SVM
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of power quality composite disturbance classification, a power quality disturbance identification method based on grid optimization support vector machine (SVM) is proposed. Firstly, MATLAB is used to generate 14 kinds of power quality disturbance signals with random parameters. The disturbance signal is processed by wavelet transform and S transform, and 8 time-frequency domain characteristic quantities are extracted. Then, the grid search method is used to optimize the parameters of SVM to determine the optimal combination of parameters. Finally, the optimal parameters obtained by the grid search method are used to construct the SVM model and realize the recognition of power quality disturbance signals. The simulation results show that under different signal-to-noise ratios, the SVM can accurately identify 14 kinds of signals by using the grid search method parameter optimization method.

articleTitle: Implementation of Search Engine with Lucene in the Document Management System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Manually managing the documents is a very challenging job, an automated or organized system can support to manage and organize the documents in an effective manner. Software like Document Management Systems (DMS) is a crucial approach that manages well to certify the quicker and effective overall working process in the organization. Searching documents takes a lot of efforts and time, recent researches have shown that office worker has spent their nearly 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> of an average day for trying to search existing documents or information within documents. In this research, a search engine with Lucene in Document Management System (DMS) has been proposed, which can index and search document in any format. This paper presents a feature of advanced searching not only the document but also full-text search within a document using the Apache Lucene. The DMS in our proposed system contains the web-based admin panel, client application, and mobile application. The results proved that the proposed searching system is a fast and improved text retrieval that helps users to search effectively and retrieved information rapidly.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Classification Method for High Spatial Resolution Remote Sensing Image
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: As the spatial resolution being higher than before, pixel-wise classification method cannot satisfy the demanding of remote sensing image classification. object-based image analysis (OBIA) is introduced into remote sensing image classification. Here, we, first, applied the vector field model (VFM) and phase congruency model to obtain the multiple edge strength. Second, watershed transform is employed to get the image segmentation. Finally, support vector machine (SVM) that is proved to be a stable model to handle high-dimensional data analysis, is used to classify the land cover. Finally, voting principle is used to get the final object-wise land cover classification by combining the pixel-wise classification and image segmentation. The experimental results shows that our proposed method can be used into land cover classification efficiently.

Author Keywords: high spatial resolution remote snesing data

articleTitle: Control of Underactuated System via Nonlinear Control Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Practical application such as rocket propulsion, robot balancing and hover board riding are innately based on inverted pendulum (IP). Presence of under-actuation and nonlinearity in an IP system creates complexity in its control process. This paper presents an analysis of sliding mode control (SMC) approach and integral sliding mode control (ISMC) approach. The stability analysis is performed using Lyapunov function for both control strategies. Analysis includes comparison of input control energy and settling time between SMC and ISMC to identify the more effective control technique. Simulation results indicate that ISMC performed efficiently in terms of defined parameters of comparison.

articleTitle: Power System Fault Diagnosis Based on Krill Herd Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: When the power system fails, the alarm signal will be uploaded, if a complex fault occurs, the amount of signal will increase greatly and the error alarm signal will be prone to occur. In order to ensure the accuracy of grid fault diagnosis, this paper introduces the actual status and alarm signal of protection and circuit breaker in the fault hypothesis. Aiming at the difference between the expected action state and the actual action state to build the objective function reflects the correctness of the hypothesis, and the error correctness indicator is used to eliminate the false alarm signals, thus an improved method of power grid fault diagnosis is given. The objective function is computed by the Krill Herd Algorithm (KHA) to obtain the actual state of protection and the circuit breaker. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by simulation of IEEE39 nodes, which shows that the method can accurately diagnose faults under complex conditions and obtain reasonable fault diagnosis results.

articleTitle: Design of Flexible Charging Facility Detection Platform with Flexible Switching Logic Verification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The topological principle and flexible switching logic of flexible charging facilities are studied, and an automatic detection platform for flexible charging facilities is designed. The platform can not only complete the automatic detection of general electric performance, conduction charging interoperability and communication protocol consistency of flexible charging facilities, but also test the correctness of flexible switching logic when multiple cells are charged simultaneously. It effectively improves the detection efficiency of charging pile and greatly improves the safety and reliability of charging pile operation.

articleTitle: Design of Radio Frequency Temperature Measurement System for Precursor Ceramic Sensor Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The precursor ceramic sensor (PDC) is a wireless passive temperature sensor with high temperature and corrosion resistance. The sensor is based on the principle of resonator, and its resonant frequency will change with the change of temperature. According to this characteristic, the resonant frequency can be found by sending a certain frequency band of radio frequency signal to the sensor and analyzing the return signal. The relationship between temperature and resonant frequency can be found by data fitting, and the temperature value can be obtained.

articleTitle: Lightweight, Fast and Secure Data Authentication Algorithm for Satellite Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Authenticity and integrity of data are two primary and critical information security services, which are generally provided together through data authentication algorithms in many of the modern-day communication applications. Cipher based Message Authentication Code (CMAC) is one of the widely used authentication algorithms and also recommended for space applications. Besides, CMAC has some limitations, such as security vulnerabilities and serial architecture. On the other hand, due to the advent and growth of Space Information Network (SIN) and the trend of miniaturization of satellites, lightweight, fast, high data rate supported algorithms are desired nowadays for satellite applications. This paper presents a new lightweight authentication algorithm which removes the shortcomings of the CMAC algorithm to provide more efficient and secure data authentication. Experimental results validate the performance superiority of the proposed algorithm over the CMAC algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Delay Control Parameters Error and Leading Simulation Method for GNSS Satellites Link Emulator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: This paper tries the first attempt in GNSS related fields, the signal emitted by four different static navigation satellites on the ground, passed the latest self-research four-channel navigation satellite link emulator, which emulating the relative motion between the satellite and the user, and adding signal transmission channel time-varying parameters (group delay, phase shift, Doppler, fading), finally, the navigation receiver receives signal to complete positioning. Essence of satellite navigation and positioning is aligning the satellite and user time, and measuring signal transmission delay. This paper has established the positioning principle model based on four-channel satellite link emulator, designed the positioning implementation process, analyzed the errors generated model, proposed a delay parameters leading simulation control method. The measured results show that it could effectively reduce the positioning error caused by the navigation satellite channel emulator. It provides an effective way to fully verify its signal performance indicators, before the navigation satellite launched.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Distribution Network Setting Program Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Aiming at the limitations of traditional relay setting calculation process program, such as its universality, extensibility and maintainability. According to the characteristics of protection, setting calculation of protection area is carried out as a unit. The object model and dynamic model of distribution network setting calculation are established by using object-oriented virtual inheritance mechanism and UML unified modeling language. The program is programmed with VC++. The program realizes different setting calculation methods of line and transformer protection areas respectively. The setting calculation program is verified by an example. The results show that the model has good scalability and maintainability.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Pattern Classification and Wavelet Denoising Based on TDOA-Chan Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of noise interference caused by electromagnetic environment in indoor positioning environment, and to reduce the smoothing effect of wavelet denoising, the time difference of arrival (TDOA) algorithm in is applied in ultra wide band (UWB) indoor positioning system. A set of initial coordinate points is calculated by TDOA equations. Fisher linear discriminant is used to classify the set of coordinate points and the motion state is judged. Then wavelet de-noising is used to process the detail coefficient according to different motion states. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm is feasible, which improves the positioning accuracy, avoids the time-consuming iteration calculation, and ensures the real-time positioning.

articleTitle: Object Extraction Algorithm Based on Saliency Prior Information
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Object extraction provides the basis for subsequent tasks such as object recognition, and its importance is self-evident. For this purpose, this paper proposes an object extraction algorithm based on saliency prior information. Firstly, the SIFT operator and the oriented edge forest method are used to extract the saliency points and the saliency edges respectively. Then construct a simple small convolutional neural network for the saliency fusion task, and fuse the saliency point and the saliency edge to obtain the saliency fusion map. Then the fusion map is added to the object extraction network structure as a priori information. In this paper, the residual network is used for the object extraction task, and finally the high-quality object extraction work is realized. The algorithm uses IOU parameters and Precision as the quantitative evaluation index, and uses qualitative analysis to comprehensively analyse the experimental results. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm has good results in both image quality and visual, and has good robustness.

articleTitle: Vehicle Blocking Effect in an Urban NLOS Radio Link Operating in the 28 GHz Band
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The impact of the presence of vehicles on an outdoor non-line of sight link operating in the 28 GHz band is evaluated using a ray tracing tool. Simulations indicate a relatively high probability for a small difference in the power received at the user equipment considering the cases of non-presence and presence of vehicles. Nevertheless, there are UE locations where such differences become large. Additionally, results suggest that the second propagation path is more impacted due to the vehicle presence and there is a slightly larger variation of the angles of departure and arrival associated to the second propagation path compared to the main first path. In order to simplify the simulation task, a spatial window is applied to the data originally obtained using a combination of a sector and omnidirectional antenna for the transmitter and receiver, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Data Storage Unit for Interoperation CBTC System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: To overcame the shortcoming that the CBTC interoperable system cannot deal with temporary speed limit informaiton across ZC control zone, a new interoperable DSU structure incorporated into the existing CBTC is studied and designed. Interface between subsystems and Data Storage Unit (DSU) systems changes are illustrated and analyzed, and also the interactions between subsystems are given. Based on characteristics of interoperation CBTC system, a novel DSU system architecture is designed, its modules are divided into the temporary speed restriction module, line database module and system maintenance module. Performance test of DSU system is conducted in the interoperation test platform in Chongqing. The results show that DSU system can meet the requirement that trains can cross the line and improve the efficiency of interoperable operation.

articleTitle: A Fault Section Location Method for Distribution Network Based on Singular Value Distance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: When a fault occurs in the distribution network, the current is small, the problem of fault location has not been well solved. Based on the characteristics of upstream and downstream transient zero-mode currents at the fault point, a fault section location method based on wavelet packet and singular value decomposition was proposed. Firstly, the wavelet packet is used to decompose the transient zero-mode current of each monitoring point, after the lowest frequency band of power frequency is eliminated, the rest wavelet packet coefficients are used as the fault information matrix to represent the difference of different frequency bands at each monitoring point. Then, the singular value decomposition of fault information matrix is carried out. The singular value obtained is used as the characteristic quantity of each monitoring point and the difference of characteristic quantity between adjacent monitoring points is measured by Euclidean distance. Finally, the fault section location criterion is constructed according to the singular value Euclidean distance value, and the section location based on wavelet packet and singular value decomposition is realized. Several simulations have verified the effectiveness and adaptability of this method.

articleTitle: Architecture Design and Strategy Research of DC Charger Considering the Three-Phase Unbalanced Treatment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low overall utilization rate and single profit model of DC charger, a DC charger device considering unbalanced treatment is proposed, which uses the idle capacity of charger to deal with the unbalanced problem of distribution network.
