The DC charger adopts constant power control, and extracts the negative sequence current component of the load current through the i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>-i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>detection method based on the instantaneous reactive power theory, superimposes it with its charging active current command. The multi-resonance PR controller is designed as current controller to realize the zero static error tracking of command current. Finally, through simulation, the rationality of the system design and the effectiveness of the control strategy are verified. The DC charger device can realize the unit power factor operation during charging. When the charger has surplus capacity or idle, the unbalanced problem of distribution network is solved to maximize the benefits of the DC charger.

articleTitle: Multi-layer Joint Classification-Metric Deep Learning for Top View Image Person Re-identification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Person re-identification (ReID) is the problem of identifying pedestrian images among multiple non-overlapping cameras. Most of the researches are based on the front view or side view of the human body. However, there are many challenges, such as occlusion, posture changes. Therefore, based on top view images, we propose a person reidentification method, called ML-CM (multi-layer joint classification-metric deep learning). The proposed method uses classification models and integrates them into the Siamese network, which is the unification of classification and metric learning. It is more suitable for top view images. In this way, minimum intra-class variance and maximum inter-class variance are achieved. We have collected the top view images of 1008 people as TVPR (top view person re-identification) dataset and conducted experiments, demonstrating that the deep features obtained by our approach can get a competitive result.

articleTitle: Dynamic Reactive Power Optimization Considering Multiple Load Curves
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In the process of dynamic reactive power optimization, the fluctuating feature of loads should be within consideration. In reality, temporal variations of different loads do not follow the same curve. Moreover, reactive power compensation devices cannot be adjusted too frequently due to their lifetime constraints. Thus, in this paper, a dynamic reactive power optimization strategy based on segmentation of multiple load curves is proposed to address this issue, aiming to optimize network losses and adjustment times of devices at the same time. Two segmentation methods are introduced and their performance were compared using case studies based on a modified IEEE 34 bus system. The experimental results indicated that the proposed method has merits on both optimization results as well as computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering Based on Factorization and Distance Metric Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Collaborative filtering predicts user preferences by modeling the user's historical behavior. Matrix factorization plays an important role in collaborative filtering. Matrix factorization use dot product to predicts rating. Nevertheless, the dot product does not satisfy the triangle inequality, which may limit their expressiveness and lead to sub-optimal solutions. This paper combines metric learning and distance factorization. Firstly, convert the scoring matrix to a distance matrix. Then the distance matrix is factorization by metric learning to obtain the position of users and items in low-dimensional Euclidean space. User preferences and distance are negatively correlated, the user is closer to the favorite item and farther away from the unloved item, that is, the user's preference is reflected by the distance. Experiments conducted on real-world data sets have shown that compared with classical algorithm, our method significantly improves the accuracy of recommendations.

articleTitle: Fractional Step Low-Pass Filters Realization Using Switched-Current Circuit and Modified Teaching-Learning-Based Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: A method of switched-current (SI) fractional step filter (FSF) implementation of low-pass filter prototype with Butterworth characteristics based on modified Teaching-Learning-Based optimization (MTLBO) algorithm was presented in this work. Firstly, fractional order Laplacian operator s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">α</sup> (0<; α<; 1) was approximated by an integer order function using continued fraction expansions (CFE) method. Then the FSF of order (1+α) was approximated using the MTLBO algorithm in order to improve the approximation accuracy. Secondly, the SI fractional step low-pass filters (FSLF) of orders 1.1, 1.5 and 1.9 with the Follow-the-Leader Feedback (FLF) structure was designed using the SI bilinear lossless integrator as the basic block. Finally, the implementation method of the FSF is verified through Matlab simulations and experimentation.

articleTitle: An Improved Strong Tracking Variable Forgetting Factor RLS Algorithm with Low Complexity for Dynamic System Identification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The recursive least squares (RLS) adaptive filter is an appealing choice in systems identification problems, mainly due to its fast convergence rate. However, it is computationally very complex, which may make it impractical for the identification of the large length impulse response, and the fixed forgetting factor RLS algorithm in the time-varying system cannot guarantee both fast convergence rate and low mean squared error (MSE). In this paper, we proposed a novel approach which improves the efficiency of the RLS algorithm. The basic idea is to apply dichotomous coordinate descent (DCD) and a practical variable forgetting factor (VFF) RLS algorithms. Compared with the traditional RLS and sliding window RLS (SRLS) algorithms, the proposed RLS algorithm applies the low computational DCD iterations without explicit division/ multiplication operations. And a real time forgetting factor updated by restoring the system noise from an error signal is designed in this algorithm, which can effectively improve the tracking performance and increase the strong robustness against process uncertainties. The simulation results show that the proposed RLS algorithm provides a lower MSE and stronger robustness than existing tracking RLS algorithms.

articleTitle: The Development and Future of Communication and Broadcasting Antennas for Amplitude Modulation Radios
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Amplitude Modulation (AM) communication and broadcasting technologies is the first, yet still widely used method of impressing sound on radio. Amplitude modulation is commonly used at Long Wave (153-279 kHz), Medium Wave (531-1,611 kHz in ITU regions 1 and 3, and 540-1610 kHz in ITU region 2), and Short Wave (2.3-26.1 MHz). Signal propagation at these bands has unique advantages such as low propagation loss, deep penetration depth, long broadcasting range, low power, etc. Therefore, amplitude modulation broadcasting has been one of the most widely used broadcasting methods since it is invented. This paper provides an overview of the history, operation, and limitation of AM broadcasting, as well as the evolution, principles and characters of antennas used for AM band broadcasting.

articleTitle: L-Grow: A Heuristic Algorithm for P-Cycle Optimization Based on Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: As optical networks present both broadband and complication trends, network reliability is an important consideration in designing optical transport networks. For the improvement of network operation status and reliability, there are a lot of research on network protection and recovery strategy. Although these algorithms can achieve better theoretical results, it is very easy to have too many P-Cycles, too much construction cost and poor performance. This paper presents a heuristic algorithm L-Grow for P-Cycle optimization construction. This algorithm optimizes the Grow algorithm, fully considers the actual cost of constructing P-Cycle and the maximum protection capability of P-Cycle. It improves the actual quality of P-Cycle by introducing the ratio parameter T of the maximum protection capability to the actual cost of P-Cycle, chooses K P-Cycles before T value to complete the screening of intermediate cycles, restricting the number of P-cycles constructed by the method of cross-merging of cycles, improves the actual performance of P-Cycles and reduces the pressure of network operation. The results show that the L-Group algorithm effectively reduces the number of P-Cycles, improves the maximum protection capability and cost efficiency of P-Cycle, reduces the pressure of network management, and improves the utilization rate of resources and network reliability.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of Inverter Interfaced Distributed Generation Grid-Connected Model with Low Voltage Ride Through Ability
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In view of the problem that the full component of d-axis of inverter interfaced distributed generation(IIDG) grid-connected point's voltage cannot accurately reflect the voltage sag of the grid-connected point when the distribution network asymmetric fault, the method of adopting the positive sequence component of that used to establish the relationship between the reference value of dq-axis of the grid-connected point's current to meet the requirement of Low Voltage Ride Through(LVRT) is proposed. The method can coordinately control the IIDG output current and reactive power to support the grid-connected point's voltage recovery, and enhance the stability of the grid-connected system. Simulation was used to verify the method in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Mapping Technology Based on SCD Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The fast parsing technology of IEC61850 SCD configuration file of intelligent substation is studied in this paper. According to the parsing results, various complex logic modules and their correlations are established within the system, such as IED, data set, virtual channel and virtual loop, besides, the fast search index is formed within the system. According to the fast data processing technology of SCD model, a high visualization of SCD model is formed and network connection diagram and logical connection diagram are automatically generated, which provides a model basis for the massive real-time data analysis needed for debugging and analysis work.

articleTitle: Optimization of Concurrency Coefficients Based on Gaussian Process Regression for Smart Grid Network Bandwidth Estimation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: With the rapid development of power communication networks, the bandwidth allocation of a certain site has become the focus of research. The current method of bandwidth calculation is to utilize the formula provided by the national grid file, including four parameters including concurrency coefficient. However, the method of determining the concurrency coefficient is mainly determined by empirical formulas, which does not perform very well. This paper proposes a method for optimizing the concurrent coefficients based on Gaussian process regression. The experiment shows that the error of the result obtained by the optimized concurrency coefficient is smaller than the original one.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Interlocking System with Interoperability Function
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The interoperability of CBTC (communication-based train control system) has shown great advantages and become an important development trend in the construction and operation of urban rail transit systems. In order to satisfy the emerging interoperability requirements, the overall function of the computer interlocking system is divided into logic processing functions and communication functions, which are processed respectively by the safety communication board and the CPU board. The interoperable computer interlocking system has multiply functions of data synchronization between the double CPUs in a single system, master-slave synchronization between two systems, system state management, safety communication, and complex safety protocol processing. Finally, system test results in Chongqing interoperability laboratory verify the availability of interoperable computer interlock systems. The realization will promote upgrading of other signaling systems and improve the performance of the overall CBTC system.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification and Test of Dynamic Model for Supercapacitors Based on Extended Kalman Filter Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Considering the complexity of the supercapacitors model structure and the accuracy of the external feature description, the dynamic model is established as the equivalent model of the supercapacitors. The model reduces inductance on the basis of the dynamic model and determines the number of RC (Rwsistor-Capacotance) networks. Aiming at the parameter identification process, the EKF (Extended Kalman Filter) algorithm is proposed to replace the EIS (Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy) method, and the algorithm is simulated and experimentally verified. The simulation and experimental results show that under UDDS (Urban Dynamometer Driving Schedule) conditions, the simulated voltage value of the supercapacitors model can follow the measured voltage value well, and the error is small. The average relative error of the supercapacitors model under UDDS conditions is less than 2.14%, which verifies the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Parallel Algorithmic Optimization for Enhanced Quasi-Maximum Likelihood Decoding on GPU
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The Enhanced quasi-maximum likelihood (EQML) decoder has better decoding performance than the traditional belief propagation (BP) decoder, but its decoding speed is greatly reduced due to its complicated computational structure. Therefore, an efficient graphics processing unit (GPU) implementation structure for EQML decoder of low-density parity-check (LDPC) code is proposed. Intra-codeword parallel and inter-codeword parallel decoding schemes on GPU are adopted instead of serial decoding on CPU. Several optimization methods have also been employed to enhance the decoder throughput, such as compressed storing and Kernel thread arrangement scheme, which improve the decoding speed without degrading the decoding performance of the decoder. Experiment results show that our GPU based implementation structure which is about two orders of magnitude faster than that of CPU implementation.

articleTitle: Space-Time Block Coded Generalized Receive Spatial Modulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: During the last few years, a number of Receive Antenna Shift Keying (RASK) schemes have been proposed. RASK has low detection complexity since only one receive antenna is activated to transmit spatial bits. Space-Time Block Code (STBC) offers an excellent way to exploit the high-rate of Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) systems, and enjoys the implementation simplicity and low decoding complexity. In this paper, a novel transmission scheme, called Space-Time Block Coded Generalised Receive Spatial Modulation (STBC-GRSM) is proposed to take benefits from both STBC and GRSM schemes. Furthermore, a simple tight upper-bound of the Average Bit Error Probability (ABEP) of the proposed system is also provided. Finally, simulation results are shown to be in agreement with our ABEP bound and they illustrate the significant performance gains that can be obtained with our STBC-GRSM scheme compared to STBC, GRSM and Space-Time Block Coded Spatial Modulation (STBC-SM).

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Acoustic Emission Structure Health Measuring Instrument Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Structural health measurement is very important in the field of non-destructive testing. Different from the traditional non-destructive testing, the acoustic emission structure health measurement has high sensitivity, low requirements on the measured environment, and low measurement cost. In this paper, a small-signal preamplifier circuit is designed for the research of FPGA-based wireless acoustic emission structure health measuring instrument. The main function is to amplify the acoustic emission signal, improve the signal-to-noise ratio, filter out the noise signal outside the frequency range, and based on this design. The 4-channel AD acquisition circuit realizes simultaneous acquisition of 4-channel signals. The hardware description language Verilog HDL is used to complete the FPGA software design. The upper computer designed by LabView is used to control the display and storage of data, and the data is sent through the wireless serial port module. The actual test shows that the acquired and displayed waveform is stable and has high detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Trench-Based NLDMOS with Stress-Enhanced Electron Mobility in the Channel and Drift Region
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In this paper, a novel CESL (SiN cap layer) strained NLDMOS with a trench-based stress modulation structure is studied by numerical simulation. A compressive CESL, instead of a tensile one which is often used in a conventional strained NLDMOS, is taken as the stressor. In common sense, though the compressive CESL will stretch the drift region, it will also squeeze the channel and hence suppress the electron mobility there. But this is not the case for our device for that the trench-based structure will alter the channel stress from compressive to tensile. Thus, the tensile stress is realized in the channel and drift regions simultaneously, whereas this can not happen in a conventional strained NLDMOS for its drift region is always compressively strained by the tensile CESL adopted. With the stress-enhanced electron mobility in gate and drift regions, the output performance of the device is substantially boosted. As another benefit, the application of a compressive CESL facilitates the integration of the strained NLDMOS with the strained PMOS in one integrated circuit.

articleTitle: Methodologies of Link-Level Simulator and System-Level Simulator for C-V2X Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: At the time of the development, standardization, and further improvement are vital to the modern cellular systems such as the next generation wireless communication (5G). Simulations are essential to test and optimize algorithms and procedures prior to their implementation process of the equipment manufactures. In order to evaluate system performance at different levels, accurate simulations of simple setups, as well as simulations of more complex systems via abstracted models are necessary. In this work, two new simulators for the sidelink Cooperative- Vehicle-to-Everything (C-V2X) communication have been implemented and carried out on both the physical layer (Link-Level (LL)) and network layer (System-Level (SL)). Detailed methodologies of the LL and SL simulators for C-V2X communication have been illustrated. In the LL simulator, we get the mapping curves of BLER and Signal-to-Noise-Ratio (SNR), which are used as a baseline for measuring the performance of the LL simulation. In addition, these mapping curves are used as the important Link-to-System (L2S) interfaces. The SL simulator is utilized for measuring the performance of cell networking and simulating large networks comprising of multiple eNBs and UEs. Finally, the simulation results of both simulators for C-V2X communication are presented, which shows that different objectives can be met by using LL or SL simulations types.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control and Management System for Recirculating Aquaculture
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Recirculating aquaculture is the future development direction of aquaculture industry. At present, most of recirculating aquaculture systems adopt the culture mode of fixed circulation water flow rate, but during different breeding stages it is difficult to maintain good water quality condition and there will exist energy and resource waste in the initial stage. Therefore, this paper proposed a culture mode with variable circulation water flow rate, which adopts fuzzy PID control combined with the gray prediction model, taking dissolved oxygen concentration as the control target. It can effectively improve the control precision of dissolved oxygen and provide new ideas for reducing energy consumption in the breeding process to some extent. The experiment results of simulation showed that the fuzzy PID control algorithm with grey prediction had better performances for the control of dissolved oxygen concentration, which effectively improved the control quality of conventional PID and fuzzy PID control.

articleTitle: Generalized Non-linear Energy Harvesting Protocol for Enhancing Security of AF Multi-Antenna Relaying Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a generalized energy harvesting (GEH) protocol and utilized a non-linear energy harvesting (EH) model for AF Multi-Antenna Relaying Systems. In particular, the GEH protocol is a optimal EH protocol based on time switching relaying (TSR) and power splitting relaying (PSR) protocols. The whole communication process contains two phases. In phase I, the source transmits certain signal to the relay, meanwhile the destination transmits an artificial noise (AN) to interfere with the passive eavesdropper. The relay harvests energy from the two nodes. In phase II, the relay node processes the two different received signals, which are transmitted from the source and destination. Then the relay amplify-and-forward them by utilizing the harvested energy. To accurately reflect the non-linear nature of the practical EH circuit of GEH-based systems, we apply a special kind of quasi-concave function named logistic (sigmoidal) function to model the input-output characteristic. We also derive a new analytical formula for proposed generalized non-linear energy harvesting protocol on ergodic secrecy capacity. The effect of the number of relay antennas N, the source transmitted power Pthe destination transmitted power Pd on ergodic secrecy capacity are investigated. The simulation results show that as N, P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub>, Pd increase, the ergodic secrecy capacity of GEH system increases accordingly. Moreover, the GEH protocol can provide higher non-linear ergodic secrecy capacity than time switching relaying (TSR) protocol and almost perform as better as power splitting relaying (PSR) protocol.

articleTitle: Research on Coordination Dispatching Strategy of Active Distribution Network and Intermittent Energy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: It is a technical difficulty for the safe and economic operation of active distribution network to control and manage distributed generators, distributed energy storage and load flexibly and effectively to eliminate the influence of distributed energy uncertainty on grid. In order to realize the full consumption of a large number of intermittent energy sources in active distribution network, this paper proposes an optimal control strategy for active distribution network considering energy storage system and controllable load. And a multi-objective optimal dispatching model with the lowest active power dispatching cost and the smallest intermittent energy reduction for active distribution network is established. The improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the model. Finally, a simulation system is constructed to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Intelligent Substation Network Security Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In recent years, the development of intelligent substations has been very rapid. It has received extensive attention from experts in the power industry on a global scale. This indicates that the field of intelligent substations is a very important direction for future research and the widespread use of intelligent substations makes the grid system more intelligent. However, the rapidly developing intelligent substation network also has many security risks and is often attacked by different hackers. There are many studies on the safety of industrial control protocols. However, the research on the defense of intelligent substation communication messages is still in its infancy, especially for the research on smart substations using IEC62351 communication protocol. This paper focuses on the information security of intelligent substation systems which based on the IEC62351 communication protocol. This paper focuses on the confidentiality and real-time performance of GOOSE messages and SV (Sample Value) messages in intelligent substation. Combining the frame structure characteristics of the SV packet with the characteristics of the TEA encryption algorithm, the core field of the SV packet containing the electrical quantity information is encrypted by the TEA encryption algorithm, which can effectively prevent the SV message from being illegally stolen. According to the structural characteristics of GOOSE messages, three special fields of GOOSE messages are encrypted by TEA encryption algorithm. This paper proposes an improvement scheme for intelligent substation based on IEC62351 communication protocol, and proposes an optimization scheme for intelligent substation information security.
